common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one final production avatar illustration for a youth learning app. High-end hand-painted semi-realistic character key art, richly illustrated cinematic finish, not a photograph or cosplay snapshot. Strong character design and identity, carefully painted face and hair, believable proportions, detailed clothing, confident expression, polished lighting and depth. Bust portrait in 6:7 format: face centered, entire head with 12% top margin, shoulders and upper chest visible. Dark atmospheric backdrop with soft colored cinematic light and subtle bokeh. Clean elegant composition designed for a collectible card, readable at 64px. Natural adolescent/young-adult proportions, no toddler cartoon, no chibi, no flat vector shapes, no excessive photographic skin pores, no crowd, no text, no watermark, no border.
